senses.gloss: f. (preced.) invalidation, declaring void; also absolution for cause (v. הַתָּרָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 10:8">Ned. X, 8</cite> <he>הֲפָרַת נדרים כל היום</he> the right (of the father or the husband) to declare a vow void lasts the whole day on which it came to his notice (to sunset); Y. ib. 42ᵃ bot. <he>הפר נדרים מעת לעת</he> twenty four hours; <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 6:1">Tosef. ib. VI, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 157a:7">Sabb. 157ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 87b:1">Ned. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>מה הקמה ממנו אף ה׳ ממנו</he> as the confirmation may be partial, so may the invalidation &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 36a:1">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לו ה׳</he> cannot be absolved from.
<cite ref="Shevuot 29b:1">Shebu. 29ᵇ</cite> top <he>כי היכי … ה׳</he> in order to make absolution impossible.
